name: SDR / Radio
description: Hardware-gated 433.92 MHz sensor snapshots plus installed SDR, AIS, and radio-control utilities.
help_text: RTL-433 exposes hardware-gated device, frequency, rate, gain, decoder, duration, analyzer, metadata, decoded-output, and bounded raw-IQ controls. AIS still needs exact native parameter mapping, artifacts, and attached-tuner tests.
